description: This file defines a class 'VertexAIGPTOSSTransformation' that inherits from 'OpenAIGPTConfig' and customizes GPT parameter support for a specific VertexAI GPT-OSS model. It includes methods to extend supported parameters and remove certain parameters based on function calling support.
